paite: Mipi bang a om kua ahia? Huan thil hilhchetna kua ahia thei? Mihing pilna in amai avaksak a, amai takna akikheng hi.
english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

paite: K'on thuhilh, Pathian thuchiam lam thu ah, kumpipa thupiak zui in.
heading: Kumpipa Thu Mang In
english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

paite: A-omna mun a kipan paikhe ding in kinoh ke'n; thil gilou ah engtat ke'n; ama'n lah a-utut ahih sek ngal a,
english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

paite: Kumpipa thu in thilhihtheihna aneih ziak in, "Bang ahia na hih?" Kua'n ahia akiang achi thei ding?
english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

paite: Thupiak zuite'n thil gilou athei kei ding uh; huan mipil lungtang in hun leh vaihawmna atheikhen zel.
english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

paite: Thiltup chiteng ah lah hun leh vaihawmna a-om ngal a; mihing haksatna lah atung ah athupi ngal a.
english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

paite: Ahong om ding lah athei ngal kei a; bangchi in a-om dia chih amah kua'n ahilh thei dia le?
english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

paite: Kha lentang ding in kha tung a thilhihtheihna neimi a-om kei; sihna ni tung ah leng thilhihtheihna anei sam kei. Huan huai kidouna ah panna a-om kei; piak a om gitlouhna in amah ahunkhe sam kei ding hi.
english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

paite: Hiai tengteng ka mu a, nasep chiteng ni nuai a hih ah ka lungtang ka pia a; asiatna ding in mi khat in midang tung a thilhihtheihna aneih louh hun a-om hi.
heading: Migilou Leh Midiktat
english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

paite: Huan giloute vui a om ka mu lai a, huan han ah ahong ua; huchi in hihdikte mun siangthou a kipan apaimang ua, khopi ah mangngilh in a-om uhi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

paite: Gilou nasep kintak a gawtna akibawl louh ziak in, huaiziak in mite tapate lungtang gilou hih ding in huai ah koihkip in a-om hi.
english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

paite: Mikhial in gilou zakhat vei hih in, anite hihsau mahleh, Pathian kihta mite amau a ding in ahoih ding chih ka thei mahmah hi, ama a laudan siamte.
english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

paite: Himahleh giloute a ding in ahoih kei ding, anite leng asausak kei ding a, huai lah limliap bang ahi; Pathian ma a laudan asiam louh ziak in.
english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

paite: Bangmah lou leitung a hih a om a-om a; midiktat omta bang hileh leng, ama tung a migilou nasep dungzui in ahong om nak hi; huai lou in migiloute omta bang hileh leng, midiktatte nasep dungzui in atung uah ahong om hi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

paite: Nek leh dawn a vualnuam a om kan a ni nuai a mihing in thil hoihzaw aneih louh ziak in, vualnopna ka phat hi. Pathian in amah ni nuai a apiak adamsung ni tengteng a asepgimna ah amah toh om gige ding ahi ngal a.
english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

paite: Pilna thei ding leh leitung a hih a om thu-le-la mu ding a ka lungtang ka suk lai in; sun hiam zan hiam a mit a ihmut muh louh lah a-om ngal a.
english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

paite: Huchi in Pathian thilhih tengteng ka mu a, huchi in ni nuai a thilhih mihing in amukhe thei kei hi; zongkhe ding in mihing nakpitak in pang lezong, amuh louh ding ziak in; huai lou in, mipil in thei kisa mahleh, amukhe thei kei ding hi.
english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.
